keyPoints.en: Mechatronic design combines mechanical, electronic and computer/control systems.
keyPoints.bm: Reka bentuk mekatronik menggabungkan sistem mekanikal, elektronik dan komputer/kawalan.

keyPoints.en: Examples: robot vacuum, automatic door, washing machine, smart dustbin.
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: vakum robot, pintu automatik, mesin basuh, tong sampah pintar.

keyPoints.en: Input (sensors: ultrasonic, IR, LDR, temperature) → process (microcontroller) → output (motors, servos, LEDs, buzzers).
keyPoints.bm: Input (penderia: ultrasonik, IR, LDR, suhu) → proses (mikropengawal) → output (motor, servo, LED, pembaz).

keyPoints.en: Feedback lets the system adjust itself.
keyPoints.bm: Suap balik membolehkan sistem melaras dirinya.

keyPoints.en: Draw the block diagram → sketch the parts to modify → make the improvement → evaluate functionality.
keyPoints.bm: Lukis gambar rajah blok → lakar bahagian yang diubah suai → buat penambahbaikan → nilai kefungsian.

tip.en: Always test in the real conditions the product will be used in.
tip.bm: Sentiasa uji dalam keadaan sebenar produk akan digunakan.
